results.summary_before: This design generates Linear Timecode (LTC) for audio and video synchronisation, using counters to track time and frame count and serialising 80-bit biphase mark coded frames. It is driven by a 12 MHz clock and starts counting from 00:00:00:00 after reset, with the frame rate selected by two input pins for 24, 25, or 30 fps. The LTC output appears on a bidirectional pin and can be fed to an audio PMOD for levels usable by audio equipment, or connected directly to a logic analyser. The 29.97 fps mode is documented as not implemented, and the project is a small single-tile Verilog design.

results.summary_before: This project is a proof-of-concept digital FSK modem with HDLC framing and UART interface, targeting amateur radio packet communication at data rates from 4800 to 64000 baud. It uses a lookup-table-based waveform generator for 2FSK modulation and includes UART flow control signals. The design is intended to be paired with a future CPU to form a complete terminal node controller (TNC). Testing requires external hardware such as an RP2040 or FPGA to validate the interface.
